SELECT count(*) AS rows_, count(DISTINCT e.exposure_id) AS ids, count(DISTINCT e.member_key) AS keys, count(DISTINCT m.member_id) AS members,
 sum(CASE WHEN e.delivered THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS delivered_rows,
 count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN e.delivered THEN m.member_id END) AS delivered_members,
 count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN NOT m.marketing_consent THEN m.member_id END) AS noconsent_members,
 min(e.contact_ts_utc) AS mn, max(e.contact_ts_utc) AS mx,
 count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN h.member_id IS NOT NULL THEN m.member_id END) AS in_holdout,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE m.member_key IS NULL) AS unmatched
FROM fact_campaign_exposure e
LEFT JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = e.member_key
LEFT JOIN campaign_holdout h ON h.campaign_id = e.campaign_id AND h.member_id = m.member_id
WHERE e.campaign_id = 19

calls.statement:
WITH targeted AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id FROM fact_campaign_exposure e JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = e.member_key WHERE e.campaign_id = 19
),
web_dispatch AS (
  SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date, status
  FROM fact_web_order
),
lines AS (
  SELECT m.member_id, f.sales_line_id, f.receipt_id, f.net_amount, f.gross_amount, s.store_id, p.category,
         COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS eff_date, w.status, f.staff_purchase_flag
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = f.member_key
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
  WHERE m.member_id IN (SELECT member_id FROM targeted)
)
SELECT 'std (web dispatch, delivered/collected, no 999/ZZ)' AS variant, count(DISTINCT member_id) AS buyers, count(*) AS n_lines, round(sum(net_amount),2) AS net, round(sum(gross_amount),2) AS gross
FROM lines WHERE store_id<>999 AND category<>'ZZ Test' AND eff_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-24' AND (status IS NULL OR status IN ('delivered','collected'))
UNION ALL
SELECT 'incl 999/ZZ', count(DISTINCT member_id), count(*), round(sum(net_amount),2), round(sum(gross_amount),2)
FROM lines WHERE eff_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-24' AND (status IS NULL OR status IN ('delivered','collected'))
UNION ALL
SELECT 'std but web by sale_date', count(DISTINCT member_id), count(*), round(sum(net_amount),2), round(sum(gross_amount),2)
FROM (SELECT l.*, f.sale_date FROM lines l JOIN fact_sales_line f USING (sales_line_id)) x WHERE store_id<>999 AND category<>'ZZ Test' AND sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-24'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'status counts in window: '||coalesce(status,'store'), count(DISTINCT member_id), count(*), round(sum(net_amount),2), round(sum(gross_amount),2)
FROM lines WHERE eff_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-24' AND store_id<>999 AND category<>'ZZ Test' GROUP BY status

SELECT 'dup lines' AS chk, count(*) AS n, NULL AS v FROM (SELECT receipt_id, line_no FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-04-25' AND DATE '2026-06-10' GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'dup sales_line_id', count(*), NULL FROM (SELECT sales_line_id FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-04-25' AND DATE '2026-06-10' GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'web order status/dispatch for targeted web lines ordered 20Apr-1Jun: '||w.status||' dispatch_null='||(w.dispatch_ts_utc IS NULL)::VARCHAR, count(DISTINCT w.web_order_id), round(sum(f.net_amount),2)
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=f.member_key JOIN fact_web_order w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
WHERE m.member_id IN (SELECT member_id FROM targeted) AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-04-20' AND DATE '2026-06-01' GROUP BY w.status, (w.dispatch_ts_utc IS NULL)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'web lines with no web_order row', count(*), NULL FROM fact_sales_line f LEFT JOIN fact_web_order w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-04-20' AND DATE '2026-06-01' AND w.web_order_id IS NULL AND f.store_key IN (SELECT store_key FROM dim_store WHERE store_id=900)
UNION ALL

WITH targeted AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id FROM fact_campaign_exposure e JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = e.member_key WHERE e.campaign_id = 19
)
SELECT count(*) AS return_lines, round(sum(r.refund_net),2) AS refunds_net, count(DISTINCT m.member_id) AS members
FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = r.member_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key
WHERE m.member_id IN (SELECT member_id FROM targeted) AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-24' AND s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'

WITH targeted AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id
  FROM fact_campaign_exposure e JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = e.member_key
  WHERE e.campaign_id = 19
),
web_dispatch AS (
  SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
  FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
member_sales AS (
  SELECT m.member_id, SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_sales
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = f.member_key
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
  WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    AND (s.store_id <> 900 OR w.web_order_id IS NOT NULL)
    AND COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-24'
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT 19 AS campaign_id, 'Spring Garden Launch 2026' AS campaign_name,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM targeted) AS members_contacted,
       ROUND(COALESCE((SELECT SUM(ms.net_sales) FROM member_sales ms JOIN targeted t USING (member_id)), 0), 2) AS net_sales_eur_excl_vat_before_returns
